top_band: light yellow-green upper crown of the palm canopy (rows 1-6)
evidence: The palm tree crown has a clear top-lit upper dome (rows 1-6) in bright yellow-green, curving down into drooping front fronds, shaded underside with two coconuts (rows 7-13), and a cylindrical segmented trunk (rows 14-35) emerging from underneath with an eave shadow where the canopy overhangs.

style.evidence: The palm tree uses 5 distinct green tones on the fronds, 5 brown/tan tones on the segmented trunk, and 3 orange tones on the coconuts. Outlines are dark olive-green and dark brown matching the materials. Individual frond segments and trunk rings are well-textured with no flat fills.
